description: Find a Bronx building's BBL (the city's building ID) from a street address. Write the address the way NYC records it: house number, then EAST/WEST spelled out, numbered streets without 'th', and STREET/AVENUE spelled out, e.g. '530 EAST 169 STREET'. Returns the best matching buildings.

configuration.query:
FROM hpd_violations, evictions METADATA _score
| WHERE MATCH(address, ?address)
| STATS records = COUNT(*), best_score = MAX(_score) BY bbl, address.keyword
| SORT best_score DESC, records DESC
| LIMIT 5
